languageFormats.title: Language and Formats
languageFormats.description: The interface language, the number format used for display and the number format used for import are independent. Each one follows your operating system until you change it.

language.title: Interface language
language.description: Method names such as MARCOS stay in their standard form in every language.
language.label: Language

displayFormat.title: Display
displayFormat.description: How numbers look in tables, charts and results. Display never changes stored values.
displayFormat.label: Number format

precision.label: Decimal places
precision.hint: Shown for computed values. Calculations always use full precision.
precision.option: {count, plural, one {# decimal place} other {# decimal places}}

preview.title: Preview
preview.caption: Stored values next to how they are shown with the current settings

importFormat.title: Import
importFormat.description: How numbers are read from CSV files and text cells in spreadsheets. You can still change it for each import.
importFormat.label: Number format

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose how Mateo looks and moves.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: System follows your operating system’s light or dark setting.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Animations make steps easier to follow. Reduce them if motion is uncomfortable.

system.title: System
system.description: Follow the operating system’s reduced motion setting.

about.title: About
about.tagline: A local-first web app for classical and fuzzy multi-criteria decision making. It works offline once loaded.
about.storageValue: Kept only in this browser, on this computer
about.bestEffort: The browser may clear it when space runs low. Download projects you want to keep.
about.keep: Ask the browser to keep it
